findings.claim: The builder's monochrome nit is correct and UNDERSTATED. They claimed aggregate identity to 6 decimals; the truth is pixelwise identity - R, G and B are equal on all 921600 pixels, max |R-G| = max |G-B| = max |R-B| = 0.0, max per-pixel chroma 0.0. Combined with shader_calls.surface = 0 this is solid support for the spawned BP4-B7SPLAT-COLOR item.

The --only plumbing is behaviour-neutral for the default P,B,S case and for every non-B-7 probe. Every pid in 'order' starts with P, B or S, so _resolve_run_set returns all 22 ids and the new 'else: RESULTS.setdefault(pid, NOT_RUN)' branch never fires; probe_results.json keeps its old shape. No probe's logic changed. Two real behaviour changes, both intended: a hyphenated token is now meaningful (the old code matched on fn.pid[0], so --only B-7 previously ran P-0 only), and empty tokens from a trailing comma are filtered. setdefault cannot mask a RAN or BLOCKED row because the else-branch only runs for probes that were skipped.
